606:         let syntax = parts[1];

608:         let family = self.classify_syntax_family(syntax);

611:             ledger.last_glob = Some(glob.to_owned());
612:             ledger.last_syntax = Some(syntax.to_owned());
613:             ledger.last_shape = shape;
614:             ledger.last_family = family;
615:         }
616:         Ok((glob, syntax))
